title: Masterpieces in Vector
subtitle: Famous paintings, prints and photographs as SVG traces
intro:
Every work in this gallery is an **SVG**: a vector trace of a public-domain original, made automatically with VTracer in one of three styles: *posterised colour*, *ink* and *minimal*. Zoom in using focus mode and the edges stay sharp at any size.

The traces are interpretations, not reproductions. Each label names the original and where it is.

artworks.title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
artworks.medium: SVG vector trace (posterised colour, 16-colour palette) after oil on canvas
artworks.credit: Trace: Vernissage demo, from a public-domain image on Wikimedia Commons

provenance.event: Painted in Arles
Shown at the Salon des Indépendants, Paris
Entered the French national collections (Musée d'Orsay since 1986)
Vector trace generated with VTracer for the Vernissage demo

artworks.rights: Original in the public domain; trace dedicated to the public domain (CC0)
artworks.description: Painted on the bank of the Rhône a few minutes' walk from the Yellow House, a year before the more famous *Starry Night*. The gas lamps of Arles double in the water under the Plough.
